question.html:
a

Light of wavelength 6.0 × 10−7 m is incident on two parallel slits.

The graph shows the variation with diffraction angle θ of the intensity  of light observed on a screen far from the slits.  is the intensity of light on the screen due to one slit only.

a.i Identify a feature of this graph that suggests that the slit width is not negligible. [1]

a.ii Estimate the slit width. [2]

a.iii Outline how the central maximum is formed. [3]

a.iv Explain why the intensity of the central maximum is equal to . [2]

b

The spectrum of sodium contains two lines at wavelengths 589.0 nm and 589.6 nm.

400 slits of a diffraction grating are illuminated. Determine whether these lines are resolved in the second order.

[2]
